title: Funding & Awards
policyBody:
Before applications open for any voucher, registration, membership, travel assistance or award, GSSA publishes the eligibility requirements, the quantity available, the application method and deadline, the decision timeline, and the selection criteria.

Applicants may not help develop criteria, review applications, score applicants or approve a selection. Every selection is made by at least three non-applicant reviewers. Executive Board service creates no priority — an officer may apply only with complete recusal.
